title: Separate 🧪 Тестовый рендер entry point in main menu with its own mini-FSM

decisions.entry_point: 🧪 Тестовый рендер button in main menu (admin only) + /test_render command shortcut
decisions.reuses_pipeline: same LLM plan generation (generate_instagram_carousel_plan -> parse_carousel_plan -> enforce_default_cta_slide -> apply_theme_selection_policy -> apply_theme_override -> build_instagram_layout_specs)
decisions.skip_production_render: yes; test flow does not call render_layout_spec_html or render_layout_spec
decisions.skip_export_persistence: yes; test renders are ephemeral, no export_packages row created
decisions.removes_inline_buttons: yes; three 🧪 buttons are removed from run_insta_auto_pipeline result message to avoid duplication
decisions.style_callback: test_render_style:<style_id> with 3-segment form like before; unknown style_id returns friendly error
decisions.backgrounds: v1 passes empty custom_background_data_url; custom-background upload deferred to v2

out_of_scope: saving test renders as proper export packages
